title: BRIDGE: An Acceptance Gate to Block False Improvements in Model Updates, with a Retrospective Clinical Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29515v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Models are updated repeatedly, and an update that looks better on validation data but not on new data is a false improvement that can misguide clinical decisions. The naive rule accepts every positive validation gain and is optimistic when the same data choose and judge the update. BRIDGE is a model-agnostic acceptance gate that decides each update from predictions and the available labels, with fixed settings. Each fold of the data judges the update chosen on the other folds (cross-fitting) to reduce selection bias; acceptance requires the gain's lower bootstrap bound to exceed a margin. The four settings are (A) 11 new datasets, (B) synthetic tasks, (C) 12 retrospective clinical tasks, and (D) 39 supporting datasets. translated_title: BRIDGE：一种阻止模型更新中虚假改进的接受门控，附回顾性临床评估
translated_abstract: 模型会被反复更新，而在验证数据上看似更好但在新数据上并非如此的更新是一种“虚假改进”，可能误导临床决策。朴素的规则会接受每一个正向的验证增益，而当同一批数据既用于选择又用于评判更新时，结果会过于乐观。BRIDGE 是一个模型无关的接受门控，它基于预测结果和可用标签、以固定的设置来决定是否接受每次更新。数据的每一折评判在其余折上选出的更新（交叉拟合），以减少选择偏差；接受条件要求增益的 bootstrap 置信下界超过一个裕度。实验涵盖四种设置：(A) 11 个新数据集，(B) 合成任务，(C) 12 项回顾性临床任务，以及 (D) 39 个支持性数据集。虚假改进率从朴素方法的 19.1% 降至 BRIDGE 的 1.1% (A)，从 20.7% 降至 1.7% (B)，从 20.0% 降至 0% (C)，从 12.5% 降至 0.5% (D)；所有关于数据集或任务上降低幅度的 95% 置信区间均不包含零。
tldr: BRIDGE 提出了一种模型无关的接受门控机制，通过交叉拟合与 bootstrap 置信下界检验来拦截模型更新中的虚假改进，将虚假改进率从约 20% 降至接近零，并经 12 项回顾性临床任务验证有效。
en_tdlr: BRIDGE is a model-agnostic acceptance gate that uses cross-fitting and a bootstrap lower-bound margin test to block false improvements in model updates, cutting false-improvement rates from ~20% to nearly zero across synthetic and retrospective clinical tasks.
